---
description: gm_revenue as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: adjusting what a business takes in
arguments:
  stream: "The revenue stream to adjust, by name."
  factor: "A multiple of its takings: 1.5 is half as much again, 0.5 half as much."
  amount: "A flat sum added to its takings, in the world's main coin; negative takes away."
  days: "How many days it lasts; left out, until changed again."
  reason: "Why, in words; kept with the change."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."
  precision: "How exact: exact, approximate, vague or unknown."
  standing: "How it stands: established, proposed or assumed."
---
Adjusts a revenue stream's takings by a factor or by a flat sum, for some days or until changed again. The stream's own bounds hold: one its author closed to adjustment in play is reported. The answer gives the stream as it now stands.
